children: Anteris Technologies Global, through subsidiary AAOPL, entered into a First Amendment to its Supply & Quality Agreement with Harvey Industries Group. The amendment, signed on September 22, 2026, extends the agreement until the earlier of December 31, 2026, or execution of a new replacement agreement. All other material terms remain unchanged. The extension is intended to ensure continuity of supply and quality standards while a longer-term agreement is finalized.
